title: UI wave 3 N1: Shortcut registry, chords and store (New-modules lane)
description: Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-3/PLAN.md section N1 exactly (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) and read its Context, Rules and Notes for the implementer first; RESEARCH.md beside it has the evidence. House rules: register paths = this task's seeded Files (already registered on claim; add more only via files add); serial slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) via files add right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir on PREVIEW port 1600+N; never edit docs/design-system.md (write DESIGN DOC: text in the done note); motion checks in tests/motion-uN.spec.ts; native rendering runs only with the screen unlocked, by Claude agents or the owner; never put backticks in double-quoted shell text; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

review.note: T142 N1 approved. tsc --noEmit exit 0; vitest src/shortcuts 10/10 pass; adversarial-wp3-exports.test.ts rerun in isolation 29/29 pass, so the 3 timeouts were load-related.
